summary: Defines the scenarios in which IPv6 transition mechanisms are meant to be used in unmanaged networks, typically home or small office networks. Scenarios are specific to one subnet and described by the IP connectivity offered by the gateway and the ISP. The aim is to help evaluate which transition mechanisms suit them.

eli5.summary: Homes will switch from an old kind of internet address to a new one. This describes typical home setups so we can judge which switching tricks fit.
